title: Discovery and preclinical validation of drug indications using compendia of public gene expression data
central_claims: Comparing drug and disease expression signatures predicts drug repositioning candidates, including cimetidine for lung adenocarcinoma with specificity over renal carcinoma.

source_manifest.title: Replication Study: Discovery and preclinical validation of drug indications using compendia of public gene expression data.
source_manifest.finding: Cimetidine A549 effect was same direction but missed corrected significance; original-plus-replication meta-analysis supported inhibition, with no ACHN effect.

source_manifest.title: Drug Repositioning for Cancer Therapy Based on Large-Scale Drug-Induced Transcriptional Signatures.
source_manifest.finding: Later LINCS expression-based repurposing study validated candidates but did not directly validate the original specific prediction algorithm.
